proposal.reason: Main change is a CI/test-workflow refactor: dual-platform (M890P + OAM-810E) case generation/execution, optional HPN SDK install plumbing, rack policy scheduling, shared artifacts/reconciliation/reporting updates, and corresponding xtest definitions/tests (including the added postsil_unit_test_shm dataset).
